pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1080x1080 frame

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the top 700 rows vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.002 px in all frames; see tracks/camera_shift.csv)
camera.view: high aerial view looking steeply down (near top-down, slightly oblique: the boat's port side and the islet's slopes are visible). Ground plane = flat water/sand surface. No horizon or vanishing point in frame.
camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from depth_info + known size if a question gives them)

objects.name: boat
objects.description: small fishing boat: white hull with red waterline stripe, red-roofed white wheelhouse, white mast with rigging, light-teal deck hatch; the only moving object. Bow points left/up-left, stern right/down-right.
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the mast-free body mask (hull + wheelhouse), proxy for the object origin
objects.apparent_size_trend: body length shrinks slowly and steadily 217 -> 213 px (about -0.055 px/frame, -1.6% over the clip): the boat recedes slightly from the camera as it moves left; width ~87 px constant within noise

motion_summary_px.note: frames 0 and 1 are identical (boat at rest); it moves from frame 2 on at nearly constant pixel speed (~3.7 px/frame, per-frame jitter +-0.5 px from segmentation), straight line, along its own bow direction (heading forwards)

objects.name: boat_shadow
objects.description: dark shadow of the boat and its mast on the water, up-right of the boat; moves with the boat. Not part of the boat.

objects.name: rock_islet
objects.description: large white/grey rocky outcrop with dark shadowed right flank, top-centre/right of the frame, on the sand
objects.reliability: hand-clicked outline, +-10-15 px; its top edge touches the frame top (may be slightly cut)

objects.name: sand_beach
objects.description: beige sand spit surrounding the islet, occupying the upper-left; its lowest tip (pointing down toward the boat) is at about (370, 775); shoreline runs diagonally from upper-right (~900, 100) to the tip and from the tip up-left to (0, ~500)

objects.name: water
objects.description: dark green sea filling the lower and right parts; static texture (no wave animation measurable, frame diff ~0.02 grey levels)

events.event: boat motion starts (first displacement between frame 1 and 2)
boat still moving at end of clip, no stop / turn / contact
